subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: For the first hole at the Bombchu Bowling Alley, stand at the center and release a Bombchu so it avoids the spike trap.

evidence.quote:
The first one is very easy. Just stand at the center and release a Bombchu 
so it won't hit the spike trap.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: For the second hole at the Bombchu Bowling Alley, wait until the Cucco is clear if the hole is near the ceiling, or aim diagonally from the opposite side if it is on the side.

evidence.quote:
The second hole is always at a random spot. If it's at the center near the
ceiling, just use the same strategy as hole 1, but this time wait until the
Cucco is out of the way. ... If 
it's on the side, simply stand at the complete opposite side and plant a 
Bombchu at a diagonal angle towards the hole and it'll almost always hit it.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: For the third hole at the Bombchu Bowling Alley, stand on the third black mark from the left of the middle blue arrow and drop a Bombchu straight ahead so a ledge redirects it toward the hole.

evidence.quote:
stand right on the third black mark from the left of 
the middle blue arrow, wait until you're all clear, including the Huge Cucco, 
and drop a Bombchu straight ahead, not at the hole. ... there's actually a ledge after the 
indentation with the Huge Cucco in it that makes the Bombchu turn towards the 
hole.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Bombchus can be won as an inventory item prize at the Bombchu Bowling Alley.

evidence.quote:
You might want to get BOMBCHUS
as a prize while you're here, so you can have an item in your Inventory screen.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Blasting the boulder at the Castle Grounds reveals a Great Fairy Fountain where playing Zelda's Lullaby grants the Din's Fire magic power.

evidence.quote:
Blast the 
boulder to reveal another Great Fairy Fountain. Head in here. Summon her with 
Zelda's Lullaby and she'll give you Din's Fire, a special magic power.

subject: Death Mountain Trail guard
text: The guard at the entrance to Death Mountain Trail buys the Keaton Mask for 15 Rupees, after which 10 Rupees must be paid to the Happy Mask Shop owner.

evidence.quote:
Talk to him with the mask on and he'll buy it for 15 Rupees. ... Head back to the Happy Mask Shop and give the owner the 10 
Rupees that the mask is worth.

subject: Deku Scrub leader
text: Speaking to the Deku Scrub leader while wearing the Skull Mask inside the Secret Cave in the Lost Woods rewards an upgrade allowing Link to carry 30 Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote:
head right, left, right, left, then left again to get to a grassy 
area. Find the butterflies flying around, and walk around there to find a 
Secret Cave. Put on your Skull Mask, and head forward. A bunch of Deku Scrubs 
will pop up. We're looking for the leader of this pack. Talk to the leader 
and he'll give you a DEKU STICK UPGRADE which allows you to carry 30 Deku 
Sticks.

subject: Skull Kid
text: The Skull Kid in the Lost Woods buys the Skull Mask for 10 Rupees, requiring a 20 Rupee payment to the shop owner.

evidence.quote:
Now head back to that Skull Kid and he'll buy it for 10 Rupees. It's 
worth 20 Rupees, so you lost some money. Head back to the shop and pay the 
owner 20 Rupees.

subject: Spooky Mask
text: The kid in Kakariko Graveyard buys the Spooky Mask during the day for its full price of 30 Rupees, which is paid back to the shop owner.

evidence.quote:
Head over to Kakariko Graveyard, 
making sure it's day. You should see a very small kid. He wants to imitate 
Dampe, so give him the Spooky Mask and he'll pay the full price for it. (30 
Rupees) Well, head back to the owner and pay 30 Rupees.

subject: Bunny Hood
text: Wearing the Bunny Hood at night in Hyrule Field prevents Stalchilds from attacking.

evidence.quote:
A bonus for the Bunny Hood is that while you're wearing it at night in Hyrule
Field, the Stalchilds won't attack you.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance to Zora's River knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree to knock down a Gold Skulltula, (GOLD 
SKULLTULA: 025 out of 100) then bomb the rocks.

subject: Magic Bean salesman
text: The salesman at Zora's River sells the first Magic Bean for 10 Rupees, increasing the price on each purchase up to 10 total beans.

evidence.quote:
Talk to him and he'll sell a Magic Bean for 10 
Rupees. Now you see, this guy is a real scammer. Every time you buy a Magic 
Bean from him, he raises the price of it. ... (There should be 10 total, I think.)

subject: Secret Cave
text: Entering the Secret Cave in Kakariko Village and defeating the Redeads yields a Huge Rupee from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Remember that Secret Cave I told you about? Open it up, then 
head inside, kill the Redeads, and grab the Huge Rupee from the chest.

subject: Drawbridge
text: Standing on the drawbridge chains as it raises at night provides access to three hidden Red Rupees along the narrow edge.

evidence.quote:
During the day, head to the 
drawbridge and stand on one of the chains. Either wait for night or have it 
come immediately by playing Sun's Song and the drawbridge will go up, taking 
you with it. Now, walk along the narrow drawbridge edge and you'll find three 
hidden Red Rupees.

subject: Secret Cave
text: Climbing the ladder on the strip of land at Zora's River leads to a Secret Cave containing a small chest with a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the ladder and 
you'll find a Secret Cave, a boulder surrounded by smaller rocks, and another 
Cucco. The Secret Cave contains a small chest with a Red Rupee

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Blasting the boulder surrounded by smaller rocks at Zora's River reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
Blasting the boulder reveals another Secret Cave which is a regular 
Fairy Fountain.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Gliding from an elevated platform with a Cucco allows Link to reach a Piece of Heart sitting on a pillar in Zora's River.

evidence.quote:
Now see the Piece of Heart on the pillar? First get 
up to the other platform then use the Cucco to glide over to the Piece. (HEART 
PIECES: 12 out of 36)

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Using a Cucco at the top bridge in Zora's River allows Link to glide to the west ledge to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
At the top bridge, use the Cucco to get to the west ledge which 
contains another Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 13 out of 36)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping below the ladder near the waterfall at night reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be killed with the slingshot.

evidence.quote:
Now if it's 
night, drop below where the ladder is and you'll see a Gold Skulltula. Kill it 
with the slingshot then collect its token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 026 out of 100)

subject: Frogs
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, and Sun's Song on the log at Zora's River causes four frogs to enlarge, each giving a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby and a frog will grow large and give you 
a Purple Rupee in return. ... Play Epona's Song. 
Another frog will grow large and give you another Purple Rupee. Play Saria's 
Song and yet another frog will grow large and give you another Purple Rupee. 
Play the Sun's Song last and another frog will grow large and give you a Purple 
Rupee.

subject: Waterfall
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the mark in front of the waterfall at Zora's River causes the water to part, opening the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
Head back to the waterfall and stand on the special mark in front. Play
Zelda's Lullaby and the waterfall will recede, allowing you to enter.

subject: Diving Game
text: Collecting all the Rupees thrown during the Diving Game in Zora's Domain within the time limit awards the Silver Scale, allowing dives of up to 6 seconds.

evidence.quote:
Talk to him to play this game. He'll throw a bunch of Rupees down 
below, and you have to dive to get them in a limited time. ... If you get them all, he'll ask you to come back up to 
receive a prize. Do so, and he'll give you a Silver Scale, which allows you to 
dive down for 6 seconds.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Lighting the torches along the stairs, down the spiral ramp, and behind the waterfall reveals a treasure chest containing a Piece of Heart in Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
Light another Deku Stick from this torch, and head left down the spiral path, 
lighting all these torches (they don't stay lit for long), the final two 
torches are behind the waterfall. ... If you lit 
them all, a treasure chest with the Piece will appear. (HEART PIECES: 14 out of 
36)

subject: Bottle
text: Diving through the underwater cave from Zora's Domain into Lake Hylia leads to Princess Ruto's letter in a bottle.

evidence.quote:
find the cave 
entrance underwater. Get near it and use the Silver Scale to enter. Now you're 
in Lake Hylia. Below the Zora here is a letter in a BOTTLE. Grab it. Now you 
have the third bottle in the game.

subject: Scarecrow
text: Playing any 8 notes on the Ocarina to the scarecrow closer to shore at Lake Hylia causes him to memorize the song.

evidence.quote:
head to the two scarecrows and pull out your 
Ocarina in front of the one closer to shore. Play any 8 notes of your choice 
(write down the notes you play) and the scarecrow will remember the song you 
played.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the platform with pillars near the island with the large tree in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Head toward the island 
with a large tree.  Ahead is a platform with pillars on it. Head over there at 
night to find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 027 out of 100)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing bugs from a bottle into the dirt plot beside the Lakeside Laboratory causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote:
head 
over to the building (it's the Lakeside Laboratory) and drop some bugs from 
your Bottle to make another Gold Skulltula appear. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 028 out of 
100)

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a fish weighing 10 lb. or more at the Fishing Pond for 20 Rupees awards a Piece of Heart from the fisherman.

evidence.quote:
This is the Fishing Pond. ... At the cost of 20 Rupees, you can fish for as long as you want. We're 
looking at getting a 10 lb. fish. ... when you eventually get that 10 lb. (or 
more) fish, bring it to the fisherman and he'll give you a Piece of Heart. 
(HEART PIECES: 15 out of 36)

subject: Lord Jabu Jabu
text: Releasing a bottled fish directly in front of Lord Jabu Jabu makes him inhale the fish along with Link.

evidence.quote:
drop that bottled fish right in front of him. He'll open his mouth and 
inhale the fish, along with you in it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree on the island at the far end of Zora's Fountain knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
head to the far end where the island is. Roll into the 
tree to knock down a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 029 out of 100)

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Blowing up the wall behind the white rock in Zora's Fountain opens a Great Fairy Fountain where summoning the Great Fairy grants Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote:
Plant a 
bomb near the white rock to blow up the wall behind it. Head through it to 
enter a Great Fairy Fountain. Summoning this Great Fairy will get you Farore's 
Wind, another C item.
